about: A project declares its methodologies as children directly beneath its methodologies path, mounted or local, and may declare a product elsewhere beneath it. The config says no more than for any child; which are methodologies follows from methodologies and each path.
yaml:
pos: 2
methodologies: methodologies
bin: bin
children:
  - path: methodologies/hello
    remote: git@example.org:hello.git
  - path: methodologies/notes
  - path: products/hello
    remote: git@example.org:hello.git
    branch: next-release
